Context: repo=32f469idiscovery-bsp, mcu_series=F4, board=None, component=ADC, layer=HAL, issue_kind=bug_report, severity=medium, evidence_strength=high, rescue_applied=False, state=closed, issue_number=1
Root cause: Hello @JoCake, Thank you for your report.
Fix: Hello, Spotted minor error here, that would create incorrect debugging feedback mainly : [stm32469i_discovery_lcd.
Constraints: Validate against exact MCU/board configuration and CubeMX/CubeH7 version before applying.
Keywords: F4, HAL, ADC, bug_report, medium, bug, bsp, internal bug tracker, DSI_IO_ReadCmd, HAL_DSI_Read, hdsi_eval, LCD_Driver_ID

Technical details:
Hello, Spotted minor error here, that would create incorrect debugging feedback mainly : [stm32469i_discovery_lcd.c/int32_t DSI_IO_ReadCmd(uint32_t Reg, uint8_t *pData, uint32_t Size)](https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/32f469idiscovery-bsp/blob/f79918e76de5310aad28ebf33365f902f51df85b/stm32469i_discovery_lcd.c#L1346) inside the if condition it shouldn't be : c if(HAL_DSI_Read(&hdsi_eval, LCD_Driver_ID, pData, Size, DSI_DCS_SHORT_PKT_READ, Reg, pData)!= HAL_OK) but more: c if(HAL_DSI_Read(&hdsi_eval, LCD_Driver_ID, pData, Size, DSI_DCS_SHORT_PKT_READ, Reg, pData)== HAL_OK) Bye.

Key comments:
Hello @JoCake, Thank you for your report. ST Internal Reference: 202226 Fixed in: aa9a1770a2dc7f30d2ba2d45d62124a94cf89d54
